title: From Identifiable Causal Representations to Controllable Counterfactual Generation: A Survey on Causal Generative Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying causal generative models (e.g., FairGAN, CFGAN) that evaluate and mitigate disparate treatment and disparate impact by structurally modeling and performing interventions on sensitive demographic factors (such as gender, race, and age) within causal graphs.

Reviewing causal representation learning and counterfactual generation methods that evaluate model robustness against dataset artifacts and distribution shifts using benchmarks with induced confounders (e.g., predicting digits based on color in ColoredMNIST, or associating cows solely with grass backgrounds).
